items.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
items.summary: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

items.title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
items.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was charged £1.5m in repair and restoration costs after surrendering the lease on the 30-room mansion.

items.title: Widdecombe suspect had 'particular hostility to Reform', court told
items.summary: Kerry is charged with the murder of the 78-year-old former Conservative minister and Reform UK spokeswoman.

items.title: Lib Dem MP quits frontbench job over Ed Davey's leadership
items.summary: Deputy party leader Daisy Cooper says "the vast majority of our MPs support Ed... and are furious at this distraction."

items.title: Firing squad execution of man who killed 13 soldiers to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
items.summary: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

items.title: Alison Hammond: 'I thought I was having heart attack on air'
items.summary: The host says a health scare on live TV was one of the "scariest things I've ever been through".

items.title: Anthropic bans users from being 'cruel' to its AI systems
items.summary: The firm said users can no longer engage in "sustained and needless" abusive behaviour towards the tech.

items.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
items.summary: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.
